dosos73 is an open-source project developed to provide a free, simple tool for downloading supported files and media.

We provide this app as a free community service, without commercial goals, advertisements, or paid subscriptions.

The application source code is available for review and contribution on GitHub, with documentation for the libraries, components, sources, and licenses used.

Developer: OS73 — os73.com
Official release. See the project repository for updates, source code and component notices.
Prepare a message in your mail app. Nothing is sent automatically. Your draft stays while navigating these pages.
Enter a valid email address, subject, and message.
Message copied. You can paste it into your mail app.
No mail app is available. Copy the message and send it to contact@os73.com.
Mail composer opened. Review and send the message there.
Storage is full. Free space on the device and destination, then try again.
There is no link in the clipboard. Copy a link first.
Completed downloads are listed here. Start from Home to add a file.
Paste a link on Home and choose the format to start.
Downloads added during a transfer wait here.

Direct downloads can pause. After interruption, a verified saved prefix is reused only when the source identity matches; otherwise the file restarts safely. Media-engine downloads restart after interruption.
Paste a supported link. Audio formats will be selected when available.
Paste a public media link in the input above. Available formats depend on the source and may require access that this app does not provide.
Delete “%1$s” from storage? This cannot be undone.
Review up to 20 links separated by spaces or lines. Choose each format and folder before adding to the queue. Analysis does not start downloading.
Your incoming text was kept while analysis was running. Review it now.
Local preview only. No source is contacted.
This file cannot be previewed here. Try an external app.

Internet transfers requested links. Foreground service keeps user-started transfers visible. Notifications are optional. Selected folders use your explicit Android grant. No analytics, accounts or background clipboard reading.
This filters completed history only. Files remain in the library. Use Clear history to remove history entries.
Hide completed history and clear failed-task history? Saved files and queued or active transfers will not be deleted.
Clears temporary preview images only. Engine libraries, resumable parts, active tasks and saved files are preserved.
Transfers wait when the selected network conditions are not met. Android background limits still apply.

Safe report includes app/Android version and error code only, without source links or filenames. Retry network errors when connected; re-analyze unavailable formats; choose another folder for storage errors.
No network connection is available. Connect and retry.

Optional. Uses two verified byte ranges on compatible servers; otherwise uses one connection. Speed depends on the source and network.

A saved file needs recovery. Reconnect its storage and retry this task. The existing file has been preserved; do not start a duplicate download.
Up to 32 recent tasks, without links, names or destinations. History retention also removes old timeline entries when the log is used.
File not found at its saved location.
Folder access was denied. Grant access again in Settings, then refresh.
Storage is unavailable. Reconnect it and refresh; the saved entry is retained.
Remove only this missing file entry from the library? This action does not delete any stored file.
Off by default. Enable only for public files you trust. HTTP traffic can be read or changed in transit; HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects remain blocked.
This link uses unencrypted HTTP. Use HTTPS, or explicitly enable HTTP links in Network policy.
Calculated from the saved file when requested. Large files may take time.
